candidates.source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) — Commercial Register, Ministry of Justice
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory registry of every s.r.o./a.s. in Slovakia. Confirms the exact legal entity that signs SK banking/payments contracts, its IČO, registered seat, share capital, statutory bodies (konatelia/predstavenstvo) and shareholders (spoločníci), including foreign parents of vendor subsidiaries (e.g. terminal, core-banking and card-processing vendors). Also the anchor identifier (IČO) that all other registers key on.
candidates.legal_status: official public register; extracts non-authoritative unless issued via sluzby.orsr.sk
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search by obchodné meno or IČO; capture 'aktuálny výpis' HTML per entity; prefer resolving IČO once and then pulling structured data from RPO/RÚZ APIs rather than heavy scraping of ORSR ASP pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from justice.gov.sk services index
queries_used: obchodný register orsr.sk výpis živnostenský register zrsr.sk vyhľadávanie firiem
Slovak commercial register company financials banking technology subsidiary

candidates.source_name: Portál OR SR (sluzby.orsr.sk) — modern commercial register portal / e-services
candidates.why_relevant: Newer front-end to the same statutory data, with structured search and issuance of verified extracts; useful when the legacy orsr.sk ASP search is flaky or when an authoritative extract is needed for an entity-resolution decision on a vendor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume lookups for entity verification; avoid bulk automation, use RPO for bulk.
queries_used: obchodný register orsr.sk výpis živnostenský register zrsr.sk vyhľadávanie firiem

candidates.source_name: Živnostenský register SR (ŽRSR) — Trade Licensing Register, Ministry of Interior
candidates.why_relevant: Covers trade-licence scope (predmety podnikania) for both companies and sole traders. Useful for small SK integrators, ATM/terminal service subcontractors and installers that never appear in vendor marketing but do appear as licensed operators; the licensed activities also hint at what a vendor is actually permitted to deliver.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookup by name/IČO; detail pages have opaque hashed IDs so crawl from search results rather than guessing URLs.
queries_used: obchodný register orsr.sk výpis živnostenský register zrsr.sk vyhľadávanie firiem

candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated filing of full financial statements (súvaha, výkaz ziskov a strát, poznámky) and annual reports for every Slovak accounting unit from 2013 onward. This is the primary way to size local banking/payments vendors and competitors by revenue (tržby), profit, assets and headcount, and to see the SK P&L of foreign vendors' subsidiaries.
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 431/2002 Z.z. on accounting
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the RÚZ Open API for incremental sync of accounting units and statements keyed by IČO; fall back to PDF document download for poznámky/výročná správa where narrative detail (customers, segments) is needed.
queries_used: register účtovných závierok registeruz.sk účtovná závierka spoločnosti
register účtovných závierok účtovná závierka dodávateľ bankových systémov

candidates.source_name: RÚZ Open API — machine-readable financial statements feed
candidates.why_relevant: Documented public API for incremental retrieval of accounting units, financial statements, annual reports and statement line items. Turns the whole SK vendor-financials problem into a structured pipeline instead of scraping, and supports continuous monitoring for new filings by tracked vendors.
candidates.legal_status: open data from a state IS (operated by DataCentrum)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the incremental 'zmenene-od' style endpoints on a schedule, store by IČO + accounting period; reconcile IČO list against a watchlist of banking/payments vendors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from registeruz.sk home + open-data search
queries_used: registeruz.sk API otvorené dáta účtovné závierky data.gov.sk dataset

candidates.why_relevant: Any vendor receiving public money above thresholds (state banks, ministries, Slovenská pošta, public-sector card/terminal or IT contracts) must register and disclose its konečný užívateľ výhod (ultimate beneficial owner) plus a verification document (verifikačný dokument) written by an oprávnená osoba. The verification documents often narrate the group ownership chain and contract context — unusually rich competitive intelligence for free.
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 315/2016 Z.z.; registering body District Court Žilina
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search partner by name/IČO, capture the partner detail (KÚV list, oprávnená osoba) and download attached verifikačné dokumenty (PDF) for ownership-chain narrative.
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora konečný užívateľ výhod rpvs.gov.sk
register partnerov verejného sektora konečný užívateľ výhod IT dodávateľ

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR — RPVS service page and FAQ
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative explanation of RPVS scope, thresholds and obligations — needed to interpret absences correctly (a vendor missing from RPVS may simply be below threshold, not absent from public contracts). Also links onward to other justice registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read for methodology notes; re-check on legislative change.
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora konečný užívateľ výhod rpvs.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: Register úpadcov (RÚ) — insolvency, liquidation and pre-insolvency proceedings
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register of konkurz/reštrukturalizácia/likvidácia proceedings, administrators and claim lists. Flags distressed or failing SK vendors and competitors before it shows in filings, and is the place to check counterparty risk for a prospective partner or subcontractor in banking/payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic search by IČO of watchlist entities; JSF/XHTML front-end means session-aware scraping or manual checks — prefer Obchodný vestník feed for systematic monitoring.
queries_used: register úpadcov ru.justice.sk konkurz reštrukturalizácia vyhľadávanie

candidates.source_name: Obchodný vestník SR — official commercial gazette
candidates.why_relevant: Daily statutory publication stream: registrations and changes in the commercial register, mergers/splits (zlúčenie, splynutie, rozdelenie), liquidations, bankruptcy notices, convocations of general meetings, and notices of financial-statement deposits. This is the earliest public signal of a vendor acquisition, restructuring or subsidiary set-up in SK banking/payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily filtered search by entity name/IČO and by notice type; archive matching form detail HTML/PDF. ASPX with CSRF token in URLs — drive via the search form, not stored deep links.
queries_used: foaf.sk prepojenia firiem vlastníci "obchodný vestník" ovsr.justice.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: FinStat.sk — commercial aggregator of SK company financial and legal data
candidates.why_relevant: Cleans and normalises ORSR + RÚZ + tax/social-insurance data into per-company profiles with multi-year revenue, profit, employee counts, SK NACE classification and connections. The database browser lets you rank companies by sales within a sector — the fastest way to build a ranked list of SK banking-technology and payments vendors and to spot subsidiaries of foreign vendors.
candidates.access_status: freemium — core profile free, deep filters/exports behind Premium/ELITE/ULTIMATE subscription
candidates.legal_status: commercial ToS; bulk scraping restricted — licensed API/dataset is the compliant route
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use free profile pages for spot checks; for systematic work buy the FinStat API/dataset (ELITE/ULTIMATE) and pull by SK NACE + revenue filters. Do not scrape at volume.
queries_used: finstat.sk tržby spoločnosť platobné terminály bankové technológie dodávateľ

candidates.source_name: Foaf.sk — company/person connection graph for Slovakia
candidates.why_relevant: Graph-algorithm view over commercial-register and gazette data showing shared directors, shareholders and 'close companies'. The right tool for mapping which SK banking/payments vendors share owners or management, and for detecting shell/holding layers between a foreign vendor and its SK contracting entity.
candidates.legal_status: commercial ToS (podmienky používania published); derived from public registers
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume exploration of connection graphs for shortlisted vendors; always confirm any inferred link against ORSR/RPVS before using it as a finding.
queries_used: foaf.sk prepojenia firiem vlastníci "obchodný vestník" ovsr.justice.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: RPO — Register právnických osôb, podnikateľov a orgánov verejnej moci (Statistical Office)
candidates.why_relevant: Since Nov 2015 the legal single source of identification data for all SK legal persons and entrepreneurs, consolidating 70+ source registers. Best canonical entity-resolution backbone (IČO, legal form, SK NACE main activity, status) for building a vendor/competitor master list before enriching with financials.
candidates.legal_status: statutory register of the Statistical Office of the SR
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by IČO/name for canonical identity + SK NACE; use as join key across RÚZ, RPVS, ÚVO and gazette datasets. Verify the exact current API endpoint before wiring a pipeline.
queries_used: register právnických osôb rpo statistics.sk ÚVO register hospodárskych subjektov vyhľadávanie

candidates.source_name: ÚVO — Zoznam hospodárskych subjektov / registers of economic operators
candidates.why_relevant: Public Procurement Office registers of qualified economic operators (and the historic register of beneficial owners it maintained before RPVS). Identifies which vendors are formally pre-qualified to bid for SK public/state-bank IT and payments tenders, and links names to IČO for tender-side analysis.
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 343/2015 Z.z. on public procurement
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browse/search the zoznam by name and IČO; cross-join with RPVS entries and gazette notices to build the pre-qualified supplier universe.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from RPVS history

negative_findings.description: No statutory SK register exposes a 'banking/payments technology vendor' category. RÚZ, ORSR and RPVS are entity-keyed only; sector slicing must be reconstructed externally via SK NACE codes (e.g. 62.01/62.09/63.11/26.20/95.11) or a manually curated IČO watchlist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched sk-language terms for supplier-of-banking-systems filings; register search UIs offer name/IČO/seat filters, not activity+revenue screening. Only commercial aggregators (FinStat databáza firiem, sortable by sales and region) provide that screening.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The vendor universe cannot be discovered from the registers themselves; the registers only verify and size entities already identified from other cells. Pipeline must therefore start from a name list.

negative_findings.description: Slovakia has no free, bulk, machine-readable beneficial-ownership dataset covering all companies. RPVS covers only public-sector partners, and the AML register of beneficial owners (register konečných užívateľov výhod maintained within the commercial register under AML law) is not publicly browsable in the same way.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on konečný užívateľ výhod returned RPVS and the historic ÚVO register; no evidence found of an open, all-company UBO download.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: UBO coverage for private-sector-only vendors will be partial; ownership chains for vendors with no public-sector contracts must be inferred from ORSR shareholder entries and Foaf.sk graphs, with lower confidence.

negative_findings.description: This cell yielded essentially nothing for the 'case studies' topic. Statutory registers publish financials and ownership, not deployment references.
negative_findings.result_summary: Closest proxies found: RPVS verifikačné dokumenty (which sometimes narrate contracts and group structure) and RÚZ poznámky/výročné správy (which may name major customers or segments) — both indirect and inconsistent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Case-study evidence must come from other cells (vendor sites, procurement records, press); register cells should not be expected to deliver it.

negative_findings.description: The exact current RPO public endpoint/API base was not confirmed in-session; two different Statistical Office paths appeared (rpo.statistics.sk/rpo and a portal wcm path).
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results referenced slovensko.sk and https://rpo.statistics.sk/rpo as service entry points; no fetch was performed to confirm which is canonical today.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A pipeline built on the wrong RPO base URL would silently fail; verify before integration. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

coverage_gaps.description: No agreed master watchlist of SK banking/payments vendor and competitor IČOs exists yet, so every register source here is currently unaddressable at scale.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an IČO watchlist by cross-joining FinStat/RPO SK NACE screening with vendor names from the vendor/competitor discovery cells, then key all register collection on that list.

coverage_gaps.description: The richest normalised views (FinStat Premium/ELITE/ULTIMATE, Foaf.sk connection depth, Slovensko.Digital premium API) are subscription-gated; free tiers give per-company profiles but not screening or bulk export.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide early between (a) licensing FinStat API/datasets and (b) building directly on the free RÚZ Open API + data.gov.sk dumps + RPO. Option (b) is compliant and free but requires normalisation work.

coverage_gaps.description: International credit-bureau products for SK (e.g. Dun & Bradstreet / Bisnode-type, CRIF/Cribis) were not searched or documented in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up pass for commercial credit-bureau coverage of Slovakia if vendor financial-risk scoring is required beyond raw RÚZ filings.

coverage_gaps.description: Centrálny register zmlúv (crz.gov.sk) and the ÚVO tender/contract-award records — which reveal which entity actually signs and at what value — were only touched via ÚVO's operator register in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a procurement/contracts cell covers crz.gov.sk and ÚVO award notices, and join them to this cell's IČO backbone.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs here come from search-result evidence; several deep endpoints (RÚZ API, RPO, ru.justice.sk JSF pages, ÚVO paths) were not fetched, and some are known to be session/CSRF dependent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass and, for JSF/ASPX register front-ends, validate via the search form flow rather than deep-linking.

brief: Slovakia's statutory disclosure stack is unusually strong for vendor sizing: ORSR gives the legal entity and its statutory bodies, RÚZ (registeruz.sk) publishes full financial statements for every accounting unit from 2013 with a documented Open API, and RPVS discloses ultimate beneficial owners plus narrative verification documents for anyone taking public money — together enough to size local players, unmask foreign-vendor subsidiaries and confirm which entity signs SK contracts. Risk and change signals come from Register úpadcov and the daily Obchodný vestník, while RPO (Statistical Office) supplies the canonical IČO/SK NACE backbone that joins everything. The main constraints are that no register is sector-filterable (a vendor watchlist must be built elsewhere first), that free bulk UBO data exists only for public-sector partners, and that the convenient normalised views (FinStat, Foaf.sk, Slovensko.Digital) are commercial and should be licensed rather than scraped. All entries are pointer/verification-grade; none of them will yield case-study or partnership narrative beyond incidental detail in verifikačné dokumenty and poznámky.
